sources.text: PDO, Province of Treviso; sold 'freschissimo' (eaten fresh from the dairy), no or barely perceptible rind; exact day count not in spec found

facts.v: Traditionally made by farm housewives in winter, with the richest milk
Pasteurised milk is acidified and coagulated with calf rennet; the curd is moulded, left to acidify in a warm room, then salted in a pan or in brine
